stemMd: Six markers A through F occupy six positions. A is first and F last. B immediately precedes C; D immediately precedes E. How many orders satisfy these conditions?
explanationMd: The middle positions contain the fixed blocks BC and DE. They can occur as BCDE or DEBC, giving exactly two orders.

distractorRationale.d: The middle markers cannot be permuted freely.
distractorRationale.c: Within each block the internal order is fixed.
distractorRationale.a: Either of the two middle blocks can come first.
